feeding_claim.verbatim: At Mahaffey Farms you can trust that our cattle has spent their entire life grazing on pasture.

pickup_locations: Mahaffey Farm Store, Haughton, Tuesday and Friday 9 to 5

resold_note: The farm store also sells milk, honey, cheeses, rice, beans and produce described as locally produced, without saying they come from this farm.
notes: Verifier 2026-11-22: read homepage, grass-fed beef store page, protocols, farm store and pick up orders pages; quote confirmed on beef page. Beef page says no grain finishing (with a seasonal protein supplement) and protocols say cattle are fed and finished on grass; chickens moved daily to fresh pasture; animals rotated on the farm's pasture. Home delivery Tuesday and Thursday by zip code, pickup at the Haughton store or McCain Farms in Calhoun; homepage says it does not ship. Farm store Mon to Fri 9 to 5, Sat 9 to 3. No bulk beef offered on pages read.
